solutions.title: Sort and count qualifying papers
solutions.strategy: Sort citation counts descending and increase h while the next paper has enough citations for its rank.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm stores only counters directly, but runtime sorting may allocate auxiliary memory, so the shared Java/Python bound is kept conservative.

solutions.title: Counting buckets by capped citation count
solutions.strategy: Bucket citation counts by min(count, n), then scan possible h values downward while accumulating papers with enough citations.

timeComplexity.explanation: The bucket fill and descending scan each take linear time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The bucket array has n plus one counters.
